title: A Alibi for the Parish
author: Gideon Eriksen
blurb: Xanthe Yarrow, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
